sn34.17:1.1: Cattāro me bhikkhave jhāyī || || Katame cattāro || || Idha bhikkhave ekacco jhāyī samādhismiṃ samāpattikusalo hoti na samādhismiṃ sakkaccakārī || || [catukoṭikaṃ vitthāritabbaṃ] -samādhismiṃ samāpattikusalo hoti samādhismiṃ sakkaccakārī ca || || Tatra || pa || pavaro cāti || || Sāvatthi || ||
